Coleus Trippin
I bought a coleus plant at a garden centre. I got home and I steeped about 30 leaves in a litre of water.
I drank the tea and after about 10 minutes I felt relaxed and slight visuals were sweeping across my visions, like small dots. My perception warped and I felt a mild ecstasy high, I felt alive!
When I could no longer resist my urge to sleep  I turned out the lights and went to bed. I fell asleep fast and had the most intense and lucid dreams of my life. I would awake with a grin, knowing instantly that I was into another dream. I went to a garden center in my dream, but I was ripped out by my brother.
When I awoke I got a glass of water and went back to bed. Immediately I was plunged back into an intense dream with colorful visuals. I then awoken for my last time.
I will definitely try this again!
